title: alchemilla glabra
intro: Alchemilla glabra, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating menstrual disorders and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in regulating menstrual cycles and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla glabra include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, which help to soothe and calm the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
